messages:
maria: Heads-up — GreenCart onboarding hit a snag. They've stalled at the model key rotation step and daily API calls dropped ~60% this week. Need a short save plan we can run this afternoon? /cc @jordan @ethan
jordan: Can you paste the last 7-day usage and the onboarding checklist status?
maria: Usage snapshot (Mar 17–23): calls/day 1200 -> 480, embeddings 320 -> 130. Checklist: SSO ✅, prod keys pending, integration test failing on rotation. Customer reported `401 invalid signature` in logs.
ethan: Sounds like key rotation is the critical path. Proposed quick save plan:
- T0: 15m debug call to repro the 401 and confirm scope
- T+30m: temporarily re-issue old key with a 24h TTL and reduced scope to restore traffic
- T+1d: permanent rollout with scripted rotation + postmortem
I can run the repro call and create the temp key if we greenlight.
oliver: Add an enablement touch: short 10-min walkthrough + a one-pager "Key rotation checklist" we can drop in their workspace. Also send a 3-question feedback survey after fix: 1) Was root cause explained? (yes/no) 2) Time to resolution <24h? (yes/no) 3) Any remaining blockers? (free text). I'll draft the email template.
maria: If we re-issue the old key, do we need security approval? @ethan any ops guardrails?
ethan: Ops checklist for temp key:
1) Scope = embeddings only
2) TTL = 24h
3) Limit IPs if available
4) Notify SRE for rotation watch
I'll place the temp key into k8s secret at `staging/green-cart/temp-rotation-key` and DM the value to the call attendees.
deploy-bot: onboarding-runbook updated by @ethan — /runbooks/onboarding/key-rotation.md
jordan: I'll host the 15m debug call at 15:10 PT. Invite includes GreenCart CSM + their eng. Maria, can you send the calendar invite and include the survey placeholder?
maria: Done — invite sent. Call channel: #green-cart-onboarding. I'll record and upload notes + the one-pager after the call.
ethan: (post-call) Repro'd the 401. Temp key issued with TTL 24h and limited scope; traffic recovered to ~95% in 40m. Pushed scripted rotation to staging and ran integration tests. Canary passed. Plan: prod canary tomorrow 08:00 PT (10% -> 100%) with SRE oncall watching.
oliver: Sent the one-pager and follow-up survey to the customer's admin. Also filed a Gainsight touch: tags = [onboarding-gap, key-rotation]. I'll compile responses into a short qualitative summary.
maria: Thanks team. I'll update the internal playbook entry with the short-steps and attach the call recording. Closing this thread when the prod canary completes. :white_check_mark:
